record OvText { data:*u8; size:usize; capacity:usize; }

record OvHooks {
    user:*u8;
    type_key:fn(*OvStage,*RmdTypeSyntax,*OvText,usize,*u8)->bool;
    binding_type:fn(*OvStage,*RmdTypeSyntax,*u8)->*RmdTypeSyntax;
    expression:fn(*OvWalk,*RmdExpr,*RmdTypeSyntax,*u8)->*RmdTypeSyntax;
    statement:fn(*OvWalk,*RmdStmt,*u8)->bool;
    contract:fn(*OvStage,*RmdDecl,*u8)->*RmdName;
}

record OvGlobal {
    name:*RmdName;
    declaration:*RmdDecl;
    first:*OvFunction;
    count:usize;
    signatures:RmdMap;
    fields:RmdMap;
    next:*OvGlobal;
}

record OvFunction {
    declaration:*RmdDecl;
    group:*OvGlobal;
    syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax;
    parameters:*RmdName;
    contract:*RmdName;
    internal_name:*RmdName;
    native_name:*u8;
    source_import:bool;
    next:*OvFunction;
    all_next:*OvFunction;
}

record OvStage {
    context:*RmdContext;
    abi:*u8;
    hooks:*OvHooks;
    globals:RmdMap;
    declarations:RmdMap;
    type_keys:RmdMap;
    first_global:*OvGlobal;
    first_function:*OvFunction;
    scratch:OvText;
    failed:bool;
}

record OvLocal { syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax; }
record OvScope { parent:*OvScope; bindings:RmdMap; }
record OvWalk {
    stage:*OvStage;
    scope:*OvScope;
    result:*RmdTypeSyntax;
    depth:usize;
}
